text.autoconfig.lazypathways.title: Lazy Pathways Settings
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.enab: If enabled, mobs (monsters and animals) will create paths when walking on grass.
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.down: Time in seconds before paths start reverting back to grass (default: 760 seconds).
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.upgr: Time in seconds before stepped paths upgrade to the next wear level (default: 280 seconds).
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.perm: Enable paths to become permanent after sufficient use.
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.step: Number of times a path must be stepped on before becoming permanent (default: 12).
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.perm: Convert permanent paths into vanilla dirt path blocks instead of keeping them as custom paths.
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.enab: Blend path colors with neighboring blocks for seamless integration with terrain.
text.autoconfig.lazypathways.option.blen: How strongly path colors blend with neighbors (0.1 = subtle, 1.0 = strong blending).
